name: collapsible
description: Show and hide a region with a trigger. Unstyled Radix primitive — the look comes from what you put in it.
constraints: Use a Button as the trigger (`asChild`) so it gets focus styles and a hit area.
Label the trigger with what it reveals ("Show details"), not "Click here".
Don't hide required actions inside a collapsed region.

notes: Installed 2026-09-22 with AI Elements for the chat panel. Stock source adapted to Enpath: Phosphor icons, light-only classes, shadcn colour names rewritten to Enpath tokens.

docs.intro:
# Collapsible

Show and hide a region with a trigger. Unstyled Radix primitive — the look comes from what you put in it.

---

sections.title: What it is
sections.body:
A trigger and a content region that expands and collapses. It carries no colours of its own; Reasoning and Tool are built on it.

**Exports:** `Collapsible` · `CollapsibleTrigger` · `CollapsibleContent`

---

sections.title: Token Bindings
sections.body:
| Part | Token |
|---|---|
| Content | none — inherits its container |
| Trigger | use a Button (ghost / outline) |

---

doNot.wrong: A bare div as the trigger
